<thought>All evidence (molecular formula C6H10O2 from the mass, 13C NMR showing a carbonyl and alkene carbons, and three aliphatic carbons) points to an α,β‑unsaturated ester. The structure CH₃‑CH=CH‑COOCH₃ (methyl crotonate) fits the data, and its SMILES “CC=CC(=O)OC” is valid.</thought>
<final_answer>CC=CC(=O)OC</final_answer>
